patch.definition:
n. a piece of cloth used as decoration or to mend or cover a hole
n. a short set of commands to correct a bug in a computer program
v. to join or unite the pieces of
v. provide with a patch; also used metaphorically
patch.translation:
n. 片, 补缀, 碎片, 斑, 傻瓜
vt. 补缀, 掩饰, 拼凑, 平息
[计] 修补; 拼凑

patch map.translation:
音色映射表
[计] 音色映射表

patch sth up.translation: 给...打补钉, 缝补, 和解, 平息

patch test.translation: n. 斑片试验, 皮肤过敏试验

patch tests.translation: [医] 斑片试验, 皮肤接触试验(检过敏性)

patch up.translation: 修补, 平息, 解决争端, 拼凑, 修改

patch-up.translation: adj. 暂时的；将就的；凑合的; 复原的，恢复的；医治的；补救的

patchboard.definition: n. telephone central where circuits are completed with patchcords
patchboard.translation: n. 接线板, 配电盘; 排题板

patchcord.definition: n. a length of wire that has a plug at each end; used to make connections at a patchboard

patched.definition:
s. mended usually clumsily by covering a hole with a patch
s. having spots or patches (small areas of contrasting color or texture)

patcher.definition: n. One who patches or botches.

patchery.definition: n. Botchery; covering of defects; bungling; hypocrisy.
patchery.translation: n. 补缀, 打补钉, 拼凑

patches.definition:
n a small contrasting part of something
n a small area of ground covered by specific vegetation
n a piece of cloth used as decoration or to mend or cover a hole
n a period of indeterminate length (usually short) marked by some action or condition
n a short set of commands to correct a bug in a computer program
n a connection intended to be used for a limited time
n sewing that repairs a worn or torn hole (especially in a garment)
n a protective cloth covering for an injured eye
n a piece of soft material that covers and protects an injured part of the body
v to join or unite the pieces of
v provide with a patch; also used metaphorically
v mend by putting a patch on
v repair by adding pieces
patches.translation: n. 修补程序；补丁；斑块（patch的复数）

patchett.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 帕奇特 Pask的昵称

patchier.definition: s. irregular or uneven in quality, texture, etc.
patchier.translation: a. patchy（补缀的；补缀而成的）的变形

patchiest.definition: s. irregular or uneven in quality, texture, etc.

patchily.translation: adv. 不规则地, 散落地

patchin.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 帕钦 Pask的昵称

patchiness.definition: n. unevenness in quality or performance
patchiness.translation: 补缀的性质[状态]; 云斑

patching.definition: n. the act of mending a hole in a garment by sewing a patch over it

patchouli.definition:
n. small East Indian shrubby mint; fragrant oil from its leaves is used in perfumes
n. a heavy perfume made from the patchouli plant

patchouli alcohol.translation: [化] 广藿香醇; 绿叶醇

patchouly.definition:
n. A mintlike plant (Pogostemon Patchouli) of the East
   Indies, yielding an essential oil from which a highly valued perfume is
   made.
n. The perfume made from this plant.
patchouly.translation: n. 广藿香, 天竺薄荷, 广藿香油（制香料用）

patchwork.definition:
n. a theory or argument made up of miscellaneous or incongruous ideas
n. a quilt made by sewing patches of different materials together
n. sewing consisting of pieces of different materials sewn together in a pattern
patchwork.translation: n. 拼缝物, 拼凑物

patchwork quilt.translation: 拼布床单；用小块布缝缀的被罩

patchworks.definition:
n. a theory or argument made up of miscellaneous or incongruous ideas
n. a quilt made by sewing patches of different materials together
n. sewing consisting of pieces of different materials sewn together in a pattern
patchworks.translation: n. 拼缝物, 拼缀物；混杂物

patchy.definition: s. irregular or uneven in quality, texture, etc.
patchy.translation: a. 补缀的, 凑合的, 不调和的, 散落的, 斑驳的, 不完全的

patco.translation: [医][=prednisone,ara-C(cytarabine)，thioguanine,cyclophosphamide,and Oncovin(vincristine)]泼尼松，阿糖胞苷，硫鸟嘌呤，环磷酰胺和长春新碱
